algos.name: Algo Baileymol (Chaos Monger)
algos.thesis_one_liner: Algo Baileymol (Chaos Monger) tests whether systematic price rotation can capture persistent sector momentum better than passive market exposure.

algos.name: Commodity Input Price Rally Crb Index Vs Corporate Margin Guidance Fade
algos.thesis_one_liner: When CRB rallies >3% weekly while broad equity index stays flat, it signals input cost pressure.

algos.name: Xlu Utilities Relative Strength Rebound After Tech Drawdown Signals Risk Capitulation
algos.thesis_one_liner: When technology sector (XLK) falls sharply and utilities (XLU) simultaneously outperform over a 3-day window, it signals panic-driven rotation into defensive yields and lowest-volatility names.

algos.name: Bank Stress Index Volatility Fear Crush Reversal
algos.thesis_one_liner: VIX spikes >25 while XLF underperforms SPY by >2%, then reverses sharply as Fed rate-cut expectations emerge, driving financials outperformance.

algos.name: Financial Sector Volatility Crush Trade
algos.thesis_one_liner: When VIX drops 3+ points in a single day while the financial sector (XLF) simultaneously gaps down, it signals a washout in financial stocks despite falling macro volatility—often creating a mean-reversion bounce within days.

algos.name: Daily Spike In Google Trends For Emergency Plumber Near Me Signals Consumer Stress Lifting Home Repair Demand
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in urgent plumbing searches reveal consumer stress and rising demand for home repair services.

algos.name: Oil Price Momentum Reversal Energy Sector Bounce
algos.thesis_one_liner: When crude oil closes down 3+ days straight but bounces 2%+ on the 4th day and XLE lags, mean reversion pressure builds; XLE outperforms over next 5 days.

algos.name: Price Momentum Reversion In Defensive Sectors After Tech Crash
algos.thesis_one_liner: When XLK underperforms XLV by >4% over 5 consecutive trading days, it often signals fear-driven rotation into defensive healthcare; subsequent mean reversion favors tech outperformance.

algos.name: Semiconductor Moonshot Warning
algos.thesis_one_liner: Semiconductors often experience large daily price jumps, which can signal speculative froth and increased risk of a pullback.

algos.name: Retail Roulette
algos.thesis_one_liner: Retail stocks exhibit high volatility and frequent swings in investor sentiment, often leading to sharp drawdowns and bounces.

algos.name: Weekly Jump In Rss News Counts For Coal Shortage Signals Input Cost Pressure In Materials
algos.thesis_one_liner: Rising news volume on coal shortages signals rising commodity input costs for materials companies.

algos.name: Oil Futures Backwardation Contraction Signals Supply Tightness
algos.thesis_one_liner: Oil futures curve flips from contango to backwardation, indicating supply concerns and near-term demand pressure from energy-intensive sectors.

algos.name: Xlc Weekly Google Trends Surge In 5g Rollout
algos.thesis_one_liner: Rising interest in 5G deployment correlates with communication sector ETF strength.

algos.name: Daily Spike In Rss News Counts On Corporate Dividend Cuts
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in dividend cut announcements signal deteriorating corporate cash flow, recession expectations, and capital preservation; correlates with broad market weakness.

algos.name: Xlb Weekly Rss News Count Spike On Commodity Shortage
algos.thesis_one_liner: News spikes mentioning commodity shortages tend to lift materials sector ETFs as prices rise.

algos.name: Xle Weekly Drawdown Rebound Signal
algos.thesis_one_liner: After a weekly drawdown exceeding 5%, XLE often rebounds sharply the following week as energy prices stabilize.

algos.name: Utilities Sector Negative Price Gap Fill
algos.thesis_one_liner: A gap down of more than 1.5% that fills (closes back above previous day's close) within 3 days often leads to short-term rallies.

algos.name: Copper Futures Volatility Spike Signals Industrial Input Pressure
algos.thesis_one_liner: 20-day rolling volatility of copper futures rises >35% above its 60-day baseline, signaling uncertainty in industrial demand or supply chain stress.

algos.name: Daily Surge In Rss News Counts For Corporate Bond Downgrade Signals Credit Stress Rotation
algos.thesis_one_liner: A spike in downgrade news signals rising credit risk perception and possible sector rotation to defensive assets.

algos.name: Daily Jump In Google Trends For Bank Account Overdraft Fees
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in overdraft fee searches signal liquidity crises and account shortfalls among consumers; precedes weakness in consumer discretionary spending and loan demand.

algos.name: Daily Surge In Google Trends For Electric Vehicle Charging Station Outage Signals Green Tech Stress
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in EV charger outage searches indicate infrastructure issues creating stress in green tech adoption.

algos.name: Daily Surge In Google Trends For Emergency Food Delivery Signals Consumer Stress Lifting Staples Demand
algos.thesis_one_liner: Sudden increase in emergency food delivery searches signals consumer stress and elevated food demand.

algos.name: Weekly Rise In Google Trends For Freight Train Delays Signals Logistics Bottlenecks
algos.thesis_one_liner: Increased freight train delay searches indicate supply chain slowdowns impacting industrial logistics.

algos.name: Weekly Rise In Usgs Earthquake Activity Near Major Ports Signals Potential Freight Disruptions
algos.thesis_one_liner: Increased seismic activity near key ports can disrupt freight logistics and shipping throughput.

algos.name: Daily Jump In Google Trends For Warehouse Worker Strike Signals Labor Stress In Logistics
algos.thesis_one_liner: Rising strike-related searches reflect potential labor disruptions in logistics-heavy sectors.

algos.name: Weekly Jump In Google Trends For Truck Driver Shortage Signals Labor Stress In Transportation
algos.thesis_one_liner: Rising searches for truck driver shortage indicate labor tightness impacting freight logistics and supply chain.

algos.name: Weekly Jump In Google Trends For Warehouse Automation Jobs Signals Labor Substitution Pressure
algos.thesis_one_liner: Growing interest in warehouse automation jobs signals rising automation adoption reducing labor demand.

algos.name: Weekly Rss Count Spike On Warehouse Worker Injury Reports
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in reported warehouse worker injuries signal labor market stress, wage pressure, and operational cost escalation in logistics; presages margin compression.

algos.name: Weekly Google Trends Surge In Pest Control Searches
algos.thesis_one_liner: Spikes in pest control searches correlate with seasonal property stress and localized economic downturn; homeowners prioritize pest mitigation when neighborhood conditions deteriorate or rental markets tighten.

algos.name: Weekly Jump In Google Trends For Home Moving Truck Rental Demand Signals Housing Market Activity
algos.thesis_one_liner: Higher demand for moving truck rentals indicates rising residential relocations and housing market activity.

algos.name: Copper Price Crash Signals Industrial Capex Destruction
algos.thesis_one_liner: Sharp copper price declines (>4% in 2 days) signal weakening global manufacturing demand and industrial capex pullback expectations, often preceding industrial sector underperformance.

algos.name: Crypto Capitulation Countdown
algos.thesis_one_liner: Cryptocurrency prices often experience sharp sell-offs in times of market stress, signaling a broader retreat from risk assets.

algos.name: Daily Stock Price Volatility Spike In Xlu Relative To Spy
algos.thesis_one_liner: Utilities volatility spikes when energy cost shocks or grid stress events create input price uncertainty; relative volatility surge precedes defensive sector rotation.

algos.name: Lumber Futures Rollercoaster
algos.thesis_one_liner: Lumber futures can experience wild price swings that outpace the broader market, often correcting sharply after a rapid run-up.

algos.name: Oil Price Crash Below 50-day Ma Signals Energy Sector Mean Reversion Bounce
algos.thesis_one_liner: Daily WTI crude closes >5% below its 50-day moving average in a single session, triggering oversold mean-reversion signals in energy stocks.

algos.name: Weekly Rise In Google Trends For Solar Panel Installation Delay Signals Supply Chain Issues In Green Energy
algos.thesis_one_liner: Growing searches for solar installation delays indicate supply chain bottlenecks impacting green energy demand.

algos.name: Xlb Daily Volatility Contraction Breakout
algos.thesis_one_liner: Periods of low volatility contraction in materials ETFs often precede explosive directional moves.

algos.name: Energy Sector Sudden Weekly Volatility Spike
algos.thesis_one_liner: A 50%+ weekly spike in realized volatility often precedes strong directional moves in energy stocks.

algos.name: Materials Sector Weekly Volatility Contraction Breakout
algos.thesis_one_liner: When weekly realized volatility contracts below 50% of its 20-week average, a breakout in price often follows.

algos.name: Weekly Ev Charger Expansion In Underserved Regions
algos.thesis_one_liner: Acceleration in charger deployment outside major metro areas signals government subsidy stimulation and broadening EV adoption; correlates with XLE weakness and XLK strength.

algos.name: Weekly Surge In Google Trends For Last Minute Flight Deals Signals Travel Demand Rebound
algos.thesis_one_liner: A spike in last minute flight deal searches indicates spontaneous travel intentions increasing soon.
